style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, no drawn overlays
motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window; his body crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too, always SIDEWAYS, NEVER toward or away from the lens; legs in shot, nothing between him and the lens, never facing the lens while talking; new shot size every window; the last frame still moves
character: a glossy red lobster in a black tailcoat, a monocle, ONE huge claw and one small
second_characters: a LADY with red nails and a diamond bracelet; THREE MAIDS in white aprons; TWO FOOTMEN
props: a cream price tag on a string on his small claw; a silver plate; a white cloth; a glazed ham
prop_continuity: the tag stays on him to the last frame; the ham stands where the tank was; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a rich salon, gilt frames, velvet couches, guests clinking glasses; HE is in a glass tank of water on a marble table until 7.9, on the table after

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, calm and unhurried, even 4.3 syllables per second
audio.pacing: speech 0.7-2.5 and 2.9-7.9; voiceless outside, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable
audio.sfx: glasses clinking, cutlery, water swirl, a finger snap, a shell crunch at 8.6, water sloshing, cloth snapping

timeline.a: silent. THE LOBSTER is already at top speed in frame one and rakes the tank left to right past the lens, the feast clinking behind
THE LOBSTER kicks off the glass and crosses back right to left, THE LADY walking in beyond it
THE LOBSTER cartwheels claw over tail edge to edge, her red nails flipping his tag over as he passes
THE LOBSTER vaults over her hand and slings himself along the gravel, THE LADY snorting
THE LOBSTER drops on his back and rips edge to edge on it, claws pedalling, gravel at the lens
still on his back THE LOBSTER whips his tail and shoots back the other way, her fingers snapping above
THE LOBSTER rolls upright and climbs the gravel slope the whole frame height, A MAID running in
THE LOBSTER launches off the slope and sails edge to edge, TWO FOOTMEN gripping the tank behind him
THE LOBSTER slams the gravel and rebounds bottom of frame to top, gravel bursting under him
THE LOBSTER tears edge to edge past the lens, the tag snapping behind him
THE LOBSTER doubles back along the glass, THE MAID's hand plunging in after him
THE MAID hauls THE LOBSTER out by the big claw and runs him edge to edge to the table, water flying off him, legs still working
she drops THE LOBSTER on the plate with a crunch and he skids it across the frame, THE FOOTMEN rushing the tank out of shot, water sloshing
a THIRD MAID whips the cloth over the bare table and lands the ham where the tank stood; THE LOBSTER props up on the plate, monocle flashing, cloth still moving

must_appear: guests feasting throughout, red nails on the tag at 1.5, the tank leaving at 8.6, the ham landing at 9.3, tailcoat and monocle
negative_prompt: speech bubble, comic balloon, cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, blood, gore, night, dark scene, a still camera, the hero moving toward or away from the lens, macro on a small prop, the tank still on the table at 10.0, a frozen final frame, slow motion, any word after 7.9, silence in the tail
